title: SIG questionnaire intake — NovaBank initial request
text:
SIG questionnaire intake — NovaBank initial request

["From: Sam Choi <sam.choi@novabank.com>
To: mina.haddad@redwood.ai
Cc: security@novabank.com
Date: Mon, 01 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG intake — NovaBank initial questionnaire

Hi Mina,

Thanks for taking this — we're starting an evaluation and have a short SIG (Standardized Information Gathering) attached. Could you confirm who at Redwood will own each SIG section and an estimated delivery date? We're hoping to get an initial pass back in two weeks.

Attachments: SIG_Request_NovaBank_v1.xlsx (SIG spreadsheet) ; initial_scope.txt

Key notes:
- We need network/topology diagrams and evidence for patching cadence for infra components.
- We prefer separate PDFs/attachments for diagrams and SC access logs.

Can we schedule a 30-min kickoff tomorrow to triage and hand off section owners?

Thanks,
Sam Choi
Security Operations
NovaBank
", "From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Choi <sam.choi@novabank.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 01 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG intake — NovaBank initial questionnaire

Sam — thanks for the questionnaire and the clear scope. I'm the Redwood point of contact for this intake.

Quick plan:
- I will run intake and own submission coordination.
- Karthik Iyer to lead network/security (sections IV-VI) and collect diagrams/evidence.
- Laura Bennett to lead application security and change-management sections (sections VII-IX).

Proposed timeline: 2-week initial pass by 2026-06-15; will flag any items that require longer lead time. Can do a 30-min triage call tomorrow at 11:00 PT — does that work for you?

Mina Haddad
Manager, Trust & Compliance
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0198

To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, sam.choi@novabank.com
Date: Tue, 02 Jun 2026 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG intake — NovaBank initial questionnaire

Mina — happy to take network/security sections.

Immediate asks from my side:
- Can we get a formal request for the network diagram format (PDF vs Visio) and whether redaction is allowed? I'll need access to our infra runbook and the diagram owner (we usually provide a redacted PDF).
- Who on the infra team is owning evidence pulls for patching cadence and vulnerability scanning exports? I can coordinate but I'll need an owner and a short SLA (48h) for the first pulls.

I'll plan to collect the following artifacts: network-diagram-redacted.pdf, vuln-scan-summary.csv (last 90 days), patching-policy.md.

Thanks — Karthik
Lead Infra Security
Redwood Inference

Cc: sam.choi@novabank.com
Date: Wed, 03 Jun 2026 15:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG intake — NovaBank initial questionnaire — internal assignment and MAP

Team — recap from intake and next steps (internal inbox).

Summary: NovaBank sent SIG (attached). Confirmed as intake; kickoff scheduled 2026-06-02 11:00 PT (calendar invite sent). Deliverable: initial completed SIG spreadsheet + supporting evidence for review by 2026-06-15.

Assignments (owners):
- Network & infrastructure controls (sections IV-VI) — Owner: Karthik Iyer (karthik.iyer@redwood.ai)
- Application security, change control, and deployment evidence (sections VII-IX) — Owner: Laura Bennett (laura.bennett@redwood.ai)
- Intake coordination, submission packaging, and redaction review — Owner: Mina Haddad (mina.haddad@redwood.ai)

Immediate action items:
1) Karthik: request redacted network diagram from infra team; confirm format and expected redaction window (attach to our Drive folder).
2) Laura: assemble change-management records and build a short summary doc (change_log_summary.pdf).
3) Mina: create a checklist in TICKET-4521 and upload the SIG spreadsheet to the shared Drive folder here: https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/novabank/SIG-Questionnaire. Add placeholders for any items requiring legal review.

Attachments for NovaBank intake (placeholders): SIG_Request_NovaBank_v1.xlsx; initial_scope.txt; network-diagram-request.txt

I'll follow up with a draft of the populated SIG and a list of outstanding evidence items by 2026-06-08. If anything blocks your collection (owners or permissions), reply here and I'll escalate.

Thanks — Mina
Manager, Trust & Compliance
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0198
